subject: Sundown AI – onboarding benchmark run & acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Cross <evan.cross@sundown.ai>, procurement@sundown.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sundown AI – onboarding benchmark run & acceptance checklist

Hi Evan / Sundown procurement team,

Great to meet on the call yesterday. Per our discussion I've attached the onboarding benchmark plan and acceptance checklist so we can align on targets and schedule a validation window. High-level targets we propose for the acceptance run: 
- Tail / P95 generation latency target: <= 200 ms for a 256-token prompt (measured server-side, excluding network).
- Sustained throughput: 150 req/s for steady-state 20-minute runs (95% of minutes within +-10%).
- Spike test: 300 req/s for a 60s burst to validate graceful degradation/fallbacks.

Planned test cadence (proposed):
1) Canary warmup: 10 min warmup with synthetic traffic to prime KV caches.
2) Three 20-minute steady-state runs separated by 10-minute cooldowns.
3) One 60-second spike test at the end.

Artifacts we will provide after each run: aggregated latency histograms (p50/p90/p95/p99), per-minute throughput, server CPU/GPU utilization, and a CSV of raw request samples. Please confirm whether you want us to use your anonymized production traces or our synthetic replay; we recommend anonymized traces for most accurate tail behavior.

Attachments: [Attachment: sundown_benchmark_plan.pdf (application/pdf)]

Please confirm: (1) a preferred 3-hour window next week to run the tests (we suggested Tue 26th 09:00–12:00 PT), (2) whether your SRE team will join the run, and (3) where to drop artifacts (we can share a Drive folder and link to your HubSpot record HS-5238).

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0157

From: Evan Cross <evan.cross@sundown.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@sundown.ai, devops@sundown.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sundown AI – onboarding benchmark run & acceptance checklist

Thanks Jordan — this looks good as a starting point. A few quick clarifications from the Ops side: 
1) Data for replay: we'll provide a scrubbed set of production traces (tokenized, user IDs removed). Do you need a special format (NDJSON vs CSV) for accurate replay?
2) Observability: our SRE (devops@sundown.ai) will want to ingest telemetry into our APM during the run. Can you add the APM agent header for correlation?
3) Security: procurement asked if you can confirm retention policy for raw request logs — we prefer a 30-day retention window with secure transfer.

We can block Tue 26th 09:00–12:00 PT. Our SRE will join: Maya R. (cc'ed to devops alias).

On Fri, May 21, 2026 at 09:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

We'll proceed on the Drive format (NDJSON preferred). Please shoot over the Drive link for results and include HS-5238 in your HubSpot activity.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 12:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sundown AI – onboarding benchmark run & acceptance checklist (internal tasks)

Jordan / Ben / Lauren — quick internal split of responsibilities for the Sundown run: 
- Monica (CS): coordinate test window, validate acceptance checklist items, collect artifacts, and run post-test quality checks against sample prompts. I'll own the Drive folder and the upload of artifacts.
- Ben (AE): confirm acceptance milestone in the contract (linked to completion of three steady-state runs meeting targets). Please ensure HS-5238 has the milestone recorded.
- Lauren (Platform): provision the tracing headers and confirm we can push APM correlation headers to Sundown's APM. Also ensure our logging retention is set to 30 days for this tenant.

Operational notes: use token-preserving replay where possible (don't replay user IDs). We should schedule a pre-run 30-minute sync 30 minutes before the first canary to validate keys and agent configs.

I'll prepare the runbook and drop it in the Drive link Jordan shared.

— Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Cross <evan.cross@sundown.ai>, devops@sundown.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sundown AI – onboarding benchmark run & acceptance checklist (schedule confirmed)

Thanks Evan — confirmed for Tue 26 May 09:00–12:00 PT. Final runbook summary below so everyone has the same expectations: 
- 08:30 PT: 30-minute pre-run sync (keys, APM headers, Drive permissions).
- 09:00 PT: 10-minute canary warmup using NDJSON replay (anonymized traces).
- 09:15 PT: Steady-state run #1 (20m).
- 09:45 PT: Cooldown (10m).
- 09:55 PT: Steady-state run #2 (20m).
- 10:25 PT: Cooldown (10m).
- 10:35 PT: Steady-state run #3 (20m).
- 11:05 PT: Spike test (60s to 300 req/s).
- 11:07–11:30 PT: Buffer and quick review; artifacts uploaded to Drive by 12:00 PT.

Acceptance criteria (pass if all are met):
- Every steady-state run: median latency <= 120 ms, p95 <= 200 ms, and sustained throughput >= 150 req/s for >= 18 of 20 minutes.
- No more than 2% error rate on inference requests.
- No full service failover or data-plane restarts required for graceful degradation during spike.

Artifacts to deliver after runs: load_test_results.csv, p95_histograms.png, ramp_chart.png, and a short run notes doc. Monica will upload. We'll also post a HubSpot activity to HS-5238 with a link to the Drive folder.

If the acceptance criteria are not met we'll capture artifacts and schedule a remediation call (suggest Mon May 27 10:00 PT).

Attachments: [Attachment: sundown_benchmark_plan.pdf (application/pdf)]

— Jordan
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Evan Cross <evan.cross@sundown.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: devops@sundown.ai, procurement@sundown.ai, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sundown AI – onboarding benchmark run & acceptance checklist (results & next steps)

Jordan / Monica — thanks for running the tests this morning. Quick summary from our side: 
- We saw sustained throughput above target: peak steady-state 162 req/s, average 154 req/s across three runs.
- Median latency was ~115 ms; p95 was under 200 ms for runs 1 and 2 but spiked to ~280 ms during minutes 12–14 of run 3.
- Error rate stayed under 1%, no data-plane restarts.

I've uploaded the raw CSV and a ramp chart to the Drive folder and attached the main exported CSV here: [Attachment: load_test_results.csv (text/csv)], [Attachment: ramp_chart.png (image/png)].

Immediate asks: can Redwood confirm (1) whether the p95 spike corresponds with cache misses or GC events on your side and (2) propose mitigation steps (config tweaks, different warmup, or model-variant fallback) in a short remediation call? Sundown Ops requests a 45-minute slot Mon May 27 10:00–10:45 PT if that works for your team.

On Sun, May 24, 2026 at 02:25 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> We'll upload artifacts to Drive and post to HS-5238. Monica will coordinate the follow-up.

Thanks again — overall a helpful baseline. Looking forward to the remediation suggestions.

— Evan
VP, Cloud Ops | Sundown AI
